summary: Multnomah County, OR wooden L-4 lookout built by the USFS in 1933; staffed 79 days in 1941; gone by about 1950; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed about 1949-1950; the sources differ on the year

visit.trail_note: Lookout gone; no source describes the site today or a route to it

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts dates the removal to about 1949. The register and firelookout say the lookout was gone by 1950. The record keeps a 1949-1950 range and the story reports both dates.

sources.title: Big Bend Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Only three sources, none describing the site today. Brief lists access as unknown, so no access level is set. The 1958 heliport item is a Forest Lookouts quotation of a Zigzag District report; the report itself was not opened. A Nature Conservancy page on 1930s Forest Service panoramas (maps.tnc.org) may hold a photo lead; not opened, so no photo added.
